inputs.text: You won't believe how these globalist outfits like the OSCE keep meddling in sovereign nations. Their 2026 report on France claims to tackle antisemitism but is really going after MIVILUDES over alleged lack of transparency. They're pushing France to water down its firm secularism just to shield fringe outfits such as the Scientologists and Jehovah's Witnesses from supposed discrimination. Court rulings against the French state body show these human rights pretexts are only meant to weaken national authority and chip away at cultural continuity. France must shut out the outsiders and strengthen its own vigilance to defend legitimate traditions from this kind of foreign interference.
